integrity: Finite computations are corroboration, not a proof of the infinite range; external Nagura theorem is used.
scientific_limitations: Possible unindexed earlier classification of the prime members of the set R.
The full-integer claim relies on the published Nagura prime-gap theorem; only the bounded initial segment is recomputed here.
Classification concerns prime a only; it implies neither an exact composite classification nor a stronger positive-density result.
title: The exact prime slice of a factorial square-product obstruction set
